subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Should modelSelectionLocked be authoritative for every trusted plugin-created session, allowing its stored provider/model to bypass agents.defaults.models visibility and generic repair in both runtime selectors?
rationale: The patch establishes a broad plugin/runtime contract beyond the reported Anthropic case; code review can verify consistency, but only the owner can confirm that this is the intended long-term authority boundary.

options.title: Confirm the generic lock invariant
options.body: Treat every trusted plugin-created locked session as owner-authoritative, add exact disallowed-model coverage in both selectors, and land the refreshed patch.

options.title: Constrain the exemption
options.body: Limit bypass behavior to durable harness or CLI-backend session metadata and retain generic visibility enforcement for other locked entries.

recommendation.title: Confirm the generic lock invariant
recommendation.body: Treat every trusted plugin-created locked session as owner-authoritative, add exact disallowed-model coverage in both selectors, and land the refreshed patch.

likelyOwner.reason: The durable agent-harness and locked-session ownership history is closest to the contract decision this patch broadens.
